title: every served entry runs under the `[[app]]` blocks that match its own file, and the door under the host's snapshot
scope: which configuration snapshot a served request, a scheduled fire and a queued job run under, what one publish holds, and which keys are read per mount and which once for the process. What an `[[app]]` block may write, and how blocks fold, stay `rule:config/an-application-is-its-entry-file-path`'s and `rule:config/every-matching-app-block-applies-least-specific-first`'s.
validatedBy: the tests the goal `serve-per-mount-config` names in `crates/nvs-config/tests/snapshot.rs` and `crates/nvs-cli/tests/per_mount_config.rs`, among them `a_mount_cannot_use_a_capability_only_another_applications_block_grants`, and the attack under `tests/hostile/tools/config/app-per-application-blocks/`.
